items.source: Executes the given AbstractStringBasedJpaQuery with the given ParameterBinder.
Method to implement AbstractStringBasedJpaQuery executions by single enum values.
items.translation: 通过单个枚举值实现 `AbstractStringBasedJpaQuery` 执行的方法。

items.source: Set of classes to contain query execution strategies. Depending (mostly) on the return type of a QueryMethod a AbstractStringBasedJpaQuery can be executed in various flavors.
items.translation: 包含查询执行策略的类集。根据QueryMethod的返回类型（主要取决于此），AbstractStringBasedJpaQuery可以以多种模式执行。
